lines.zh: 我迈步很稳，脚跟先落地。
lines.en: My steps are steady, heel down first.

lines.zh: 三步之内，我就能到你面前。
lines.en: Three steps and I'm in front of you.
I brush aside the hem of my gi.
I circle you, looking for an angle.

lines.zh: 脚踩过的地方，土都实了。
lines.en: The soil packs firm where I step.
I don't like turning my back on an enemy.
Simple footwork. Enough is enough.

lines.zh: 第四只眼在额上，看得更清。
lines.en: The third eye on my brow sees clearer.
Three steps and I'm in your face.
Even retreating, I keep my eyes on you.
My shadow turns with me on the ground.
Three eyes, reading your openings.
I count the sound of the wind far off.
Arms crossed, I wait.
Even this silence is a technique.
I pace my breathing. Four counts in, slow.
I never rely on luck.
The eye on my brow never closes.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只手，像在测量。
lines.en: I raise a hand as if measuring.
Standing like this, every muscle held.

lines.zh: 我在想，你值不值得我出手。
lines.en: I'm deciding whether you're worth my effort.
I stand, my three eyes blinking in turn.
I never make a wasted move.
Letting you move first is cheapest.
I crack my knuckles.
Not smiling doesn't mean I'm angry.
In your stance, the gap is your left ribs.

lines.zh: 我看你，用的是第三只眼。
lines.en: I'm watching you with the third eye.
I underestimate no one.
If you want a fight, I'll oblige.
Don't stand so loosely.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸，比刚才快了一点。
lines.en: Your breathing's a little faster than before.

lines.zh: 这一身衣服，不适合动手。
lines.en: Those clothes aren't suited to fighting.
I speak first because I'd rather not fight.

lines.zh: 你的手放在那种地方，很危险。
lines.en: Your hand resting there is dangerous.

lines.zh: 我认得练过的人，你不是。
lines.en: I know trained people. You aren't one.

lines.zh: 退一步，我们就当没见过。
lines.en: One step back and we forget this.
I dislike chatter. Get to the point.

lines.zh: 额上的眼睛，你注意到了。
lines.en: You noticed the eye on my brow.

lines.zh: 你身后有人，我不喜欢这样。
lines.en: Someone's behind you. I don't like it.
My patience has always been limited.
If you want to test me, test me.

lines.zh: 这么近站着，你已经输了半招。
lines.en: Standing this close, you've already lost half a move.

lines.zh: 看清楚我的脚，不是我的手。
lines.en: Watch my feet, not my hands.
That came from a tricky angle.
I press my ribs and take a breath.
It doesn't hurt, but I know I'm bleeding.
I wipe it off and continue.
Blood drips on my gi; I ignore it.
This won't stop me striking.
I bite down and force my ki back in.

lines.zh: 这一下，我确实低估你了。
lines.en: That one — I did underestimate you.
Two more hits and I'd still stand.
Pain is good. It means I'm alive.
I'll eat after. No hurry.
I won't be distracted by food.
Leave it. I'll take it later.
I'll remember the gesture.
One bite won't delay anything.

lines.zh: 我不习惯别人递东西给我。
lines.en: I'm not used to being handed things.
That little? Fine.

lines.zh: 我收下，但别指望我谢你。
lines.en: I'll take it, but don't expect thanks.
Not bad. Better than camp food.
Even a fighter has to eat.
You came at me. I didn't give way.
Shoulder to shoulder, and you gave ground.
Stand further off. I dislike close contact.
My knee nearly came up.

lines.zh: 这么近，谁都打不出招式。
lines.en: This close, neither of us can use technique.
All three of my eyes narrow at once.
That was more force than I expected.
Three eyes see behind you.

lines.zh: 我们同时停下，都很有分寸。
lines.en: We both stop. Both measured.
Don't push. I'll take it as a challenge.
I've little experience with this.
I'm not good at soft words.
If you want to stay, stay.

lines.zh: 我练功的时候，你别靠太近。
lines.en: When I train, don't come too close.

lines.zh: 有人等着，倒也不是坏事。
lines.en: Having someone wait for me isn't bad.
I can't sweet-talk. I can cook.
I'll make this meal.
With you standing there, I'm at ease.
Leave at dawn. No rush.
What I promise, I do.
I catch it one-handed without bending.
This weight isn't like stone.
I tuck it away and deal with it later.
Yours. Take it back.
A few more on the ground.
I hold it up and look at it.

lines.zh: 这东西放在路中间，会绊人。
lines.en: Left in the path, someone will trip.
I move it aside.
I nudge it with my toe.
Hold it properly. Don't drop it again.

lines.zh: 你动的那一刻，我就决定了。
lines.en: The moment you moved, my mind was made up.
I lock onto your center of gravity.

lines.zh: 第三只眼看着，你藏不住。
lines.en: The third eye watches. You can't hide.
Ki is gathered at my fingertips.
This distance is just right.
I won't open with a killing blow.
Your killing intent is obvious.

lines.zh: 我迈前一步，这就是答复。
lines.en: One step forward. That's my answer.
I've noted the terrain.
You can still retreat.
If we fight, hold nothing back.
I count to three. You choose.
Your left foot lands lightly.
I lift my ki an inch higher.
I won't lose this one.
Then let it begin now.
I watch your shoulder. It moves first.
Your knee is exposed outside the armor.
I won't rush. I'll wait for your gap.
Your weight is leaning to the right.

lines.zh: 我换了个角度，你看不出来。
lines.en: I changed angle. You can't tell.
Ki turns in my palm. Steady.
Your hands are shaking. Stop forcing it.

lines.zh: 我一直站着，是为了省力。
lines.en: I stand still to save strength.

lines.zh: 第三只眼，能看见你的犹豫。
lines.en: The third eye sees your hesitation.
I've calculated the distance.
The more impatient you get, the more you'll slip.
I shift my left foot forward half an inch.
Have you seen this before?
I don't mind waiting all day.
All three eyes are on you.
Your heel has not settled.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，是最后的警告。
lines.en: My hand is raised. Final warning.
Watch closely. I strike once.
A knife-hand to the side of your neck.

lines.zh: 气功激光贴着手打出去。
lines.en: A ki laser fires right off my palm.
That punch used three-tenths of my strength.
A knee comes up. Don't take it.
I chop down from above.
I catch your wrist and twist.
I drive my palm into your chest.
Ki is still cupped in my palm, unspent.
That landed on your guard.
I never shout before striking.

lines.zh: 我要的是让你退，不是伤你。
lines.en: I want you to retreat, not to wound you.

lines.zh: 两下连击，中间没有间隙。
lines.en: Two strikes with no gap between.
This kick takes your supporting leg.
After that, I stop.

lines.zh: 三只眼一起看，你躲不掉。
lines.en: All three eyes are on you — you can't hide.
Get up. Again.

lines.zh: 我从树下走出来，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I walk out from under the tree, softly.
My gi is already tied.
The air is good here.
I don't make pointless entrances.
The third eye saw you first.
I plant my feet and look around.
I remember what needs doing today.
Ki drawn in, not flared.
I raise a hand in greeting.
Good wind for training.
I'm here. You may begin.
Footprints on the ground. Someone's been here.
I tighten my cuffs.
No need to welcome me.

lines.zh: 我看一眼就够，不用多问。
lines.en: One look is enough. No need for questions.
I know this area well.

lines.zh: 我从远处走过来的，没坐车。
lines.en: I walked here from far off. No cart.
Stand ready. Let's get to business.
Fire seared my arm; blisters rising.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，落地时卸了力。
lines.en: I fell from height and rolled off the impact.
Water's coming in. I hold my breath first.
The blast pushed; I didn't take a step back.
Something's in my side.
This force is smothering my ki.
Fighting on an empty stomach is a poor bargain.
Lightning ran through me and I held on.
Nothing underfoot. I can only raise my ki.
